title: SAP and planqc Demonstrate Enterprise Software Integration and Quantum Agents at Quantum Day Munich - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) and Munich-based neutral-atom quantum computer developer planqc have expanded their collaboration, demonstrating for the first time an end-to-end cloud integration connecting SAP’s enterprise software environment with planqc’s quantum computing stack. Unveiled at SAP’s Quantum Day Munich at the SAP Campus in Garching, the hybrid architecture links classical solvers, quantum simulators, and quantum hardware so enterprise applications can offload complex optimization problems and return computed results directly into operational workflows.

In a live demonstration, the companies executed a multi-constraint bin-packing logistics workflow that optimized the loading of a beverage delivery truck across compartment capacities, unloading directions, and refrigeration requirements using planqc’s quantum simulator. Built on the same cloud interface, SAP also introduced its first Quantum Agents to capture business constraints and orchestrate hybrid solvers without requiring end users to write quantum code, alongside plans to establish a dedicated Munich quantum team and test business workloads directly on planqc’s neutral-atom hardware starting in 2027.
